items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: There was another woman named Etta, or sump'n like that, played across the street from us who was the queen of all of 'em.

ctx.x: There was another woman named Etta, or sump'n like that, played across the street from us who was the queen of all of 'em. She only played and sang alone. But she'd come into those jam sessions, and tear up some of those men. She and her husband just played it alone over in that little club and they made good money. (inaudible)
Well, it's very interesting, you know, I know that name Countess Johnson, but I've never heard anything about her. She was really a good pianist?
